name: io.github.johanschnor/cashfloow
description: Cash flow, receivables, sales and inventory analyses from e-conomic for Claude. English and Danish.

environmentVariables.name: ECONOMIC_APP_SECRET_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: e-conomic AppSecretToken from your app at e-conomic.com/developer. Leave empty for sample data and the demo account.

environmentVariables.name: ECONOMIC_AGREEMENT_GRANT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: e-conomic AgreementGrantToken, given when you approve the app in your e-conomic. Leave empty for the demo account.

environmentVariables.name: CASHFLOOW_LANG
environmentVariables.description: "en" for English tools and answers. Empty for Danish.
